statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-105517 is a stack buffer overflow in the 9P TWALK path used by mount.9P. This rebuild disables 9P at build time (USE_9P=OFF) and no longer ships the nfs-ganesha-mount-9p binary package, matching the mitigation Debian documents for nfs-ganesha 9.14-2. See https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-105517
